about: Every automation that touches the kit or a course, with what it does and what has been verified. 'active' means it is configured and has fired; 'proposed' means it is not configured. lastRun copies the scheduled task's own record: for a task that wakes an existing session, SUCCEEDED means the wake was delivered, not that the session's work succeeded. Read 2026-11-06 from list_triggers and GitHub; a coordinator run updates it.

automations.name: Kit checks
automations.responsibility: run_checks.sh on template, template-unset, Medicinal-chemistry and module courses, Chromium and WebKit, on every pull request and push to main
automations.schedule: every pull request, every push to main, by hand
automations.verified: yes: runs and results on GitHub; WebKit jobs cancelled at the 45-minute limit when the WebKit install is slow (2026-11-06)

automations.name: Kit feature port
automations.kind: scheduled task trig_017nw2kiZvgqCKkgWcKuvA8V, wakes session 'Kit feature porter'
automations.responsibility: ports queued features from course repositories into the kit as pull requests (review/port-queue.md, review/porter-policy.md)
automations.verified: yes: draft port PRs #11, #13-#22, #24-#26 and merged #36 came from it

automations.name: Kit update run
automations.kind: scheduled task trig_01QduqhookGDD8HxANEbLq4w, wakes session 'Kit updater'
automations.responsibility: builds and checks a /preview/ of each kit course behind the kit's main; never makes it live without Louis's reply 'approve updates for <course>'
automations.verified: yes: Medicinal-chemistry previews built and promoted after Louis's approval (COURSES.md)

automations.name: Kit porter feedback check
automations.kind: scheduled task trig_013q6ZcmPDygMRdnkeUqCbDr, wakes session 'Kit feature porter'
automations.responsibility: triages new non-Claude comments and reviews on the porter's PRs and on #57, against a checkpoint on branch porter/feedback-checkpoint; small authorized fixes only, larger work left to the nightly port run
automations.schedule: 05:30, 10:30, 15:30, 20:30 America/Chicago (about 30 minutes after each ChatGPT review window)

automations.name: BDK daily review
automations.kind: scheduled task trig_01VZfFupWhJzsgL7Q4f7mU2a, fresh session each time
automations.responsibility: BDK review on a branch daily-review/<date> with a pull request; never publishes
automations.verified: yes: last run finished; its output is in the BDK repository

automations.name: ChatGPT GitHub review
automations.kind: external (ChatGPT), not run by the kit
automations.responsibility: reviews pull requests in the kit and its branches
automations.verified: schedule from Louis; its comments appear on pull requests (for example #47 comment 6647518091)

automations.name: Reminder: Sikazwe slides-to-avoid list
automations.kind: one-time scheduled task trig_01FdGD737ZiCduLsqHkGF1sb, wakes the DEENT session
automations.responsibility: reminds Louis to send Dr. Sikazwe's list; then the DEENT session adjusts the bank with his approval

automations.name: Intro Pharmacology tasks (3)
automations.responsibility: daily polish, nightly ingest, reading reminder for Exam 4

automations.name: Kit coordinator daily
automations.kind: scheduled task (proposed), would wake session 'Kit updater'
automations.responsibility: coordinator/RUN.md: plan by lifecycle and change, review what is due, record outcomes, prepare improvements on branches, never publish
